profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at CACI International Inc
profile.summary:
- 18+ years experience in programming and development; custom design skills, problem analysis and resolution, delivered under high-pressure and time sensitive environments.
- Software architect, responsible for the design and implementation of embedded proprietary communication protocols
- Strong background in issues related to application, cryptography, secure network protocols 
- Bilingual: Spanish and English; strong communication skills
- Results oriented software engineer who adapts easily for requirements found in server and PC application development
- Proven and proficient use of multiple computer systems and process-driven software development
